# Schemap — AI Database Context Compiler

> Schemap compiles database schema metadata into compact, deterministic context maps (`schemap_database_context.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.cursor/rules/schemap.mdc`) for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot).

## Key Features & Capabilities

- **AI Readiness Score (`schemap doctor`)**: Diagnoses schema health (0-100 score), detects missing foreign keys, unmapped abbreviations, and un-commented tables.
- **Context Compilation (`schemap context`)**: Compiles token-optimized Markdown, JSON, MCP, or Mermaid ER diagrams. Cuts raw SQL dump token footprint by up to 80%.
- **Agent Integration (`schemap agents`)**: Generates agent instruction files (`CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, Cursor MDC rules) with safe marker preservation.
- **Foreign Key Join Solver (`schemap join`)**: Resolves shortest join paths across foreign key graphs and generates ready-to-run SQL `JOIN` clauses.
- **Interactive Remediation (`schemap fix`)**: Interactively accepts inferred foreign key relationships and abbreviation mappings, updating `schemap.yaml`.
- **CI/CD Diff Gate (`schemap diff`)**: Tracks schema structural changes (`+`, `~`, `-`) and fails CI builds on breaking changes (`--fail-on-breaking`).

## Supported Databases
- PostgreSQL
- SQLite
- MySQL
- Turso / libSQL
- Oracle

## Quickstart & Installation

```bash
# Install globally via pipx (recommended)
pipx install schemap-tool

# Or using uv
uv tool install schemap-tool

# Onboarding pipeline
schemap quickstart

# Compile AI context map
schemap context
```

## Comparisons & Technical Guides
- Schemap vs Raw pg_dump SQL DDL: https://schemap-tool.pages.dev/vs-pg-dump.html
- Schemap vs Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers: https://schemap-tool.pages.dev/vs-mcp-sql.html
